Deploy and activate ESET security products  
After setting up your cloud-based or on-premises management console, you can proceed with creating installers of ESET security products and deploying them across your endpoints and servers.  
Please refer to your activation email for setup instructions and a comprehensive list of products available with your subscription. If you have lost your activation email, use the Lost subscription form to have it resent. 

Find the modules you would like to deploy 
All modules are OS specific (Windows, macOS, Android, etc.). Find your preferred module based on your operating system, click DOWNLOAD NOW and follow the deployment instructions. 

NOTE: Are you sure you want to deploy manually? 
Managing your endpoints centrally is easier and more efficient. Our security management console is included free with your subscription . Central management saves time and provides 24/7 peace of mind.
